1119.description: A rear lunge where the back leg crosses behind the front one, hitting the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1183.description: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1247.description: Rotating a medicine ball from side to side while seated. It works the obliques.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the ball by your hip.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and move with control.

1311.description: A push-up with your hands placed wider than your shoulders. It puts more emphasis on the chest and less on the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开比肩宽。
保持身体从头到脚呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1375.description: A standing calf raise using a cable for resistance. It builds the calves with a steady pull through the whole movement.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto the cable machine handles or attach a cable ankle strap to your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
握住电缆机手柄或将电缆脚踝带固定在脚踝上。
尽可能高地伸展脚踝，将脚后跟抬离地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1439.description: A shrug on a lever machine without handles to grip, so the lift comes from the traps alone. Version 2 of the machine drawing.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles or bars with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight.
Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄或杆，保持手臂伸直。
保持背部挺直，将肩膀尽可能高地抬向耳朵。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1503.description: A simple band move pulling the arms apart in front of you. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders and helps posture.
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly with control.

1567.description: A kettlebell clean where your palm stays open and you catch the bell on your forearm. It teaches a smooth hip-driven pull.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge down and grab the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to pull it up.
Keep your hand open and guide the bell to rest at your shoulder.
Lower it back with control and repeat, then switch sides.

1631.description: A concentration curl using a cable. The elbow stays braced so the biceps do the work.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with an underhand grip and rest your elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the cable handle towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then inhale and slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部靠在大腿内侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将电缆手柄向肩膀卷曲，同时收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后吸气并慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1695.description: A single-leg squat with a stability ball between your back and a wall for support, building one-sided leg strength.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Lift one foot and balance on the other leg.
Lower into a squat while the ball rolls down the wall.
Press through your heel to stand back up.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

1759.description: A deep single-leg squat with the other leg held out in front. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward.
Slowly lower your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower yourself down.
Lower until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右脚抬离地面并向前伸展。
弯曲左膝并将臀部向后推，慢慢降低身体。
降低身体时，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低直到左大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动左脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

1823.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with radial deviation.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1887.description: Classic lunge-style calf stretch with the back heel kept down.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1951.description: A seated stretch that opens one hip by turning the leg outward.
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2143.description: Dumbbell circles around the body with straight arms, going out to the side and overhead. Works the shoulders through a wide range.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing down.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly rotate your arms in a circular motion, bringing the dumbbells in front of your body and then overhead.
Continue the circular motion, bringing the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
将手臂伸直至两侧，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢地以圆周运动旋转手臂，将哑铃放在身体前面，然后举过头顶。
继续圆周运动，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2207.description: A roller stretch that reaches forward to lengthen the sides of your back. Helps loosen the lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the roller with both hands in front of your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms forward and roll the roller down towards your feet, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly roll the roller back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住滚轮放在身体前方。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
向前伸展双臂，将滚轮向脚部方向滚动，感受背阔肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸几秒钟，然后慢慢地将滚轮滚动回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2271.description: A boxing left hook thrown with a hip and torso rotation. Builds rotational power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your left hand up to protect your face and your right hand by your chin.
Rotate your hips and pivot on your left foot as you extend your left arm forward in a punching motion.
Twist your torso and engage your core muscles to generate power in the punch.
Snap your arm back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
左手举起以保护脸部，右手握住下巴。
旋转臀部并以左脚为轴心，同时以出拳动作向前伸展左臂。
扭转你的躯干并调动你的核心肌肉以产生出拳的力量。
将手臂拉回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

2335.description: A seated machine calf press. Builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lower portion of the platform and position your knees under the lever pad.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Press the lever pad down by extending your ankles, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器的座椅，使您的肩膀与杠杆垫对齐。
将脚趾放在平台的下部，并将膝盖放在杠杆垫下方。
抓住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
伸展脚踝，将杠杆垫压下，尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2399.description: A seated cable twist, rotating the torso against resistance. Works the obliques and core.
instructions: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the range of motion, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持核心参与，慢慢地将躯干旋转到一侧，将电缆拉过身体。
在动作范围结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢旋转回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2463.description: A crunch variation where you reach up to your toes with band tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your feet.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold the band ends and reach toward your toes.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2527.description: A lunge with the front foot on a vibrating plate for added stability work.
instructions: Place one foot on the vibrating plate and step the other back.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Hold the bottom briefly.
Push up to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2719.description: An overhead press with a heavy viking-press frame, building shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand inside the frame and grab the handles.
Lift the handles to shoulder height and set your feet.
Brace your core and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.

2783.description: Drawing the arm back in a horizontal plane, working the rear shoulder and upper back.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height.
Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level.
Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2911.description: A walking carry with one dumbbell overhead and one at your side. The mismatch trains shoulder stability and trunk control.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
Swap positions and repeat.

3167.description: A squat combined with a towel row, so legs and upper back work together. You pull the towel toward your chest as you sink down.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a towel in front of you with your palms facing down.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
As you lower into the squat, simultaneously pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then slowly return to the starting position while extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，手掌朝下，将毛巾放在身前。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
当你下蹲时，同时将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3231.description: A standing forward bend reaching both hands toward the toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3295.description: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your body straight, lift your legs up until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for 10-20 seconds.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
保持身体挺直，抬起双腿直至与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，目标是 10-20 秒。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3359.description: A standing press with cables that trains the chest while your core keeps you steady.
instructions: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.

3487.description: A beginner-friendly pull-up built from a bar across two chairs, with the feet on the floor and knees bent. It builds lats and arm pulling strength.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.

3551.description: A lateral shuttle run at speed to raise the heart rate.
instructions: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.

3679.description: A sit-up with the arms crossed on the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双臂交叉于胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3743.description: A single-leg squat with your rear foot resting on a chair, which builds strength and balance.
instructions: Stand facing away from a chair and rest the top of one foot on it.
Step your front foot forward so it is stable.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3871.description: A front squat with a band adding resistance, building strong quads and a tall, braced torso.
instructions: Set up a band under your feet or anchored to the floor and attach it to the bar.
Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels against the band tension.
Keep your chest tall throughout.

3935.description: A push-up from your knees with the lower body elevated, shifting the work to the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel with your knees on a bench or step and hands on the floor.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight and your elbows at about 45 degrees.

3999.description: A standing cycling crunch bringing the elbow to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Stand with hands behind your head.
Lift one knee while rotating your torso.
Touch your elbow to the knee.
Switch sides in a pedaling rhythm.
Stay upright.

4063.description: Standing curl using a band under your feet. It builds the biceps with rising tension.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

4127.description: A dead bug with added weight to increase core work.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a weight above your chest.
Raise your knees over your hips.
Extend the opposite arm and leg.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides, keeping your back flat.

4191.description: Short range lateral raises that keep tension on the side delts.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides.
Stay within the mid range, between hip and shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid shrugging.

4255.description: A hip bridge with your legs straight and heels on the floor. It shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and heels on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

4383.description: An explosive rotational throw that starts with a step behind. It builds power through the hips and trunk.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall, holding a medicine ball at hip height.
Step your rear foot behind you and load your weight onto it.
Rotate your hips and torso toward the wall.
Throw the ball hard into the wall at chest height.
Catch it, reset, and switch sides after your set.

4447.description: A glute bridge with your feet raised and a band adding resistance. Targets the glutes with a deep range of motion.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on a bench and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Bend your knees and place your arms by your sides.
Push your knees out against the band and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

4511.description: A yoga backbend that strengthens the glutes and opens the chest and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower down slowly.

4575.description: A standing one-arm row with a band to train the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand facing it.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm extended.
Step back until there is tension and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

4703.description: A deep squat paired with an overhead reach or press, working the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat deep, keeping chest up.
Drive up out of the squat.
Press your arms overhead as you stand.
Lower your hands and repeat.

4767.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your knees in a circular path. It targets the lower abs and obliques.
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight and legs together.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Move them in a circle to one side and back down.
Keep your body from swinging.
Alternate the circle direction each rep.

4831.description: A floor pulldown where you slide your hands on a towel from overhead to your sides. It works the lats without any equipment.
instructions: Kneel with your hands on a towel placed on a smooth floor, arms stretched forward.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbows down and back as your hands slide toward you.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slide back out slowly to the start.

4895.description: A calf raise that finishes with a small circle of the heels. It works the calves and the ankle control.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Trace a small circle with your heels while staying high.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Reverse the circle direction on the next rep.
Keep your knees straight and your balance steady.

4959.description: A form check drawing for the lunge, showing correct and incorrect positions. It reminds you how to train the thighs safely.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up to the start.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

5023.description: Seated leg raise with added weight. It challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and weight secured to your legs or between your feet.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Raise your legs up while keeping them as straight as you can.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.
Keep your back from rounding too far.

5087.description: Rotate your forearm up and back against a cable with your upper arm at shoulder height. It strengthens the rotator cuff external rotators.
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and back without moving your upper arm.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5151.description: Use a leg kick to help drive yourself up from a handstand push-up. It lets you handle more reps and volume overhead.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Bend your hips and knees slightly, then drive them back out as you press.
Press up to lockout.
Keep your core tight and move carefully.

5407.description: A deep wide-stance squat while holding a stick overhead. Opens the inner thighs and hips and challenges shoulder mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the bottom position for 20-30 seconds.
Press up through your feet to stand.

5471.description: Hip-extension variation on a back extension bench where you keep a relaxed, rounded upper back to bias the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.

5663.description: Deadlift with the bar held behind you, a quad-friendly lift.
instructions: Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your back flat.

5855.description: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder and press it overhead. It combines a hip drive with a shoulder press for full-body power.
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up to your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bicep near your ear.
Lower to the shoulder, then back to the floor, and switch sides.

5983.description: A short flow of plank, chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog. Used to link poses together.
instructions: Start in plank pose.
Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.

6047.description: A walking-style lunge stepping forward with bottles in your hands. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.

6303.description: A kneeling backbend with hands on your heels. It opens the chest and stretches the thighs and hips.
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward.
Lean back and reach for your heels.
Lift your chest and let your head drop gently if comfortable.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then rise.

6367.description: A standing wrist curl with a low cable behind you, giving steady tension on your forearm flexors.
instructions: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

6559.description: Lifting your toes up against the weight of a plate to strengthen the muscle on the front of your shin.
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest a plate on your forefoot.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6751.description: A side-lying leg lift that goes back on a diagonal. It focuses on the glutes and outer hip.
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

6879.description: An inversion where your forearms and head share the load, building shoulder strength and balance.
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the mat with your fingers interlaced.
Set the crown of your head lightly on the floor against your hands.
Lift your knees and walk your feet toward your face.
Lift your legs slowly, using your core, until they point to the ceiling.
Keep most of the weight in your forearms and shoulders.
Hold briefly, then lower with control and rest in child's pose.

7199.description: A lying hip abduction with bent knees that targets the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7263.description: Seated punching move that fires the abs and shoulders with quick uppercut punches.
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

7327.description: Leg extension with toes angled in to shift the emphasis on the quads.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Turn your toes slightly inward.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads for a second.
Lower the weight slowly.

7455.description: One-legged sideways hop that builds power and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

7583.description: Pull a neutral-grip handle down to your upper chest on a cable stack. It builds the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown station, thighs secured, and grab the neutral-grip handle.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.

7839.description: A back-lying core drill that moves opposite arms and legs while keeping the lower back flat.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.

8223.description: A renegade row with your feet on a stability ball. The unstable base makes the core work harder.
instructions: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

8479.description: A single-leg squat on a bosu ball with the free leg reaching back for balance, challenging the legs and stability.
instructions: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

8799.description: A single leg deadlift performed on a hack squat machine. It trains the glutes and hamstrings with extra stability.
instructions: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

8991.description: Holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, you hinge and extend the back. It loads the lower back, glutes and core.
instructions: Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows against your chest.
Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid hyperextending at the top.
Use a light weight and control the bar.

9311.description: A wide-grip push-up held halfway down. It builds chest strength under tension.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.

9503.description: A suspension-strap row with wide elbows that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

9695.description: A one-arm landmine press from a half-kneeling position, easy on the shoulder and tough on the core.
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold the end of the landmine at your shoulder.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

10463.description: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.

10591.description: Seated knee flexion with a band under your foot, hugging one knee. It adds resistance to the bend.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10655.description: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet flat. It trains the front thighs.
instructions: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out until legs are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your lower back stable.

10847.description: Reformer leg work: frog press followed by circles. It trains the hips and inner thighs with control.
instructions: Lie on the reformer with your feet in the straps or on the bar.
Bend your knees and open them out, heels together, in a frog shape.
Press your legs straight.
Circle them out, around and back together.
Reverse the circle direction after a few reps.
Keep your back steady on the pad.

10911.description: Curling and squeezing the toes while seated. It wakes up the small muscles of the feet.
instructions: Sit on a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Curl all your toes down as if gripping the floor.
Squeeze for a couple of seconds.
Relax and spread your toes wide.
Repeat smoothly.

0031.description: The standard standing barbell curl. A simple and effective way to build the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and exhale as you curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the bar until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly begin to lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，在弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。
继续抬高杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0095.description: Shrug the shoulders toward your ears while holding the bar. Builds the upper traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of you with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your back straight throughout the exercise.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃。
在整个练习过程中保持手臂伸直和背部挺直。
将肩膀尽可能高地抬向耳朵，挤压斜方肌顶部。
保持一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0159.description: A seated wide-grip cable row on a decline. Targets the upper back.
instructions: Sit on the decline bench facing the cable machine with your feet securely placed on the footrests.
Grasp the cable attachment with a wide overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the cable towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the contraction, then slowly release the cable back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在面向缆绳机的下斜长凳上，双脚牢固地放在脚踏板上。
用宽的正手握法抓住电缆附件，手掌朝下。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将电缆拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在收缩的峰值处暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将电缆释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0223.description: A cable side crunch from a low pulley, bringing the elbow toward the hip. It works the obliques with steady tension.
instructions: Attach a cable handle to a low pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Grasp the handle with the hand furthest from the machine and place your other hand on your hip.
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
With your abs engaged, bend sideways at the waist, bringing your elbow down towards your hip.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 将电缆手柄连接到低滑轮上并站在机器旁边。
用距离机器最远的手抓住手柄，并将另一只手放在臀部上。
双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
收紧腹肌，腰部向侧面弯曲，将肘部向下拉向臀部。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0287.description: A seated Arnold press variation. You rotate the palms as you press, working all heads of the shoulder.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.
Rotate your wrists as you lift, so that your palms end up facing forward at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在有背部支撑的长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝向身体，肘部弯曲。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，手掌朝前。
抬起时旋转手腕，使手掌在动作的最高点朝前。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0351.description: Lying on a bench, you bend and straighten the elbows to lower dumbbells toward your forehead and press back up. A classic triceps builder.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the dumbbells down towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
将哑铃向前额方向降低，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0415.description: Standing, you raise dumbbells one after the other. It works the shoulders with a controlled rhythm.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Raise one dumbbell to the side, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Alternate between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将一个哑铃举到一侧，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地面平行。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
双臂交替进行所需的重复次数。

0479.description: A step-up on a bench or box finishing with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and balance.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy bench or step.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that foot to step up and lift the other knee high.
Step back down with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Repeat, then switch legs.

0543.description: A kettlebell hinge and carry style move that works the hips and lower back while you keep a flat back and steady core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise the kettlebell up to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Extend your arm fully overhead, straightening your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell back down to shoulder height, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将壶铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，伸直肘部。
将壶铃降低至肩膀高度，然后返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0607.description: Seated on a machine, you press the handles down by extending your elbows. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and fully extend your arms in front of you.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the handles towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the handles back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，并将手臂完全伸展到身前。
保持上臂不动，弯曲肘部，慢慢将手柄向前额降低。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将手柄推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0735.description: You lie on your back and curl your torso up toward your knees. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0799.description: A step up where you cross a knee or foot over your body. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and trunk.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy step or box.
Step up with one foot and bring the other knee across your body.
Step back down with control.
Keep your chest tall and core tight.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

0863.description: A side-lying rotation with a light dumbbell, turning the forearm upward with the elbow at the side. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your upper arm against your side and your elbow bent 90 degrees.
Hold a dumbbell in your hand with your palm facing down.
Keeping your upper arm against your side, slowly rotate your forearm upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 侧躺在平坦的长凳上，上臂靠在身体两侧，肘部弯曲 90 度。
手中握住哑铃，手掌朝下。
保持上臂靠在身体两侧，尽可能缓慢地向上旋转前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0927.description: A straight-leg raise forward while standing with a band. It works the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankle and anchor it behind you.
Stand tall holding support.
Raise the straight leg forward.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

0991.description: A hip hinge pulling a band through the legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at ground level.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and push your glutes back, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将阻力带连接到地面上坚固的锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向前迈一步，在弹力带中产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并将臀部向后推，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
向前推动臀部并挤压臀部以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
